verse.verse_1: In the Name of Allah, the Merciful, the Most Merciful
verse.verse_2: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds,
verse.verse_4: Owner of the Day of Recompense.
verse.verse_5: You (alone) we worship; and You (alone) we rely for help.
verse.verse_6: Guide us to the Straight Path,
verse.verse_7: the Path of those upon whom You have favored, not those upon whom is the anger, nor the astray. (Amen please answer)
